data.title: 玛修 · 奥特瑙斯出击
data.description: 【玛修 · 奥特瑙斯出击】迦勒底机库的出击平台上，玛修身着黑色奥特瑙斯装甲，装甲的间隙透出幽幽蓝光，她握紧拳头深吸一口气——「新装甲的出力……已经完全掌握了。出击！」
data.action: 站在机库出击平台上握紧双拳，深吸一口气后准备前进
data.camera: full-body frontal shot, closed fists and launch platform visible
data.promptProse: Mash stands on the hangar launch platform with both fists closed at her sides, breathing steadily before advancing toward the catapult ramp. Black Ortinax armor and planted armored boots remain complete in the frontal full-body view. Gantries rise beside the ramp and telemetry screens recede behind. Cool hangar lamps illuminate her focused face and armor planes, while thin blue joint lights mark the darker gaps and platform shadows.
